title: Wright brothers' powered flight
place: Kill Devil Hills, near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, United States
summary: The Wright brothers made the first controlled, sustained flights in a powered airplane.

notes.problem: Place: source says flights were at 'a location now part of the town of Kill Devil Hills', about 4 miles south of Kitty Hawk.

superlativeSource: made the first sustained flight by a manned heavier-than-air powered and controlled aircraft
